title: Porous Silicon Microparticles for Delivery of siRNA Therapeutics
protocol: Oxidize non-functionalized porous silicon particles in a 30% hydrogen peroxide solution at 95 °C for 2 hours.
Aminate oxidized particles in a 2% (3-aminopropyl)triethoxysilane solution in isopropyl alcohol for 2 days at 65 °C with gentle stirring.
Centrifuge the particle suspension for 30 minutes at 18,800 x g.
Wash particles twice in isopropyl alcohol and three times in ethanol using brief sonication to suspend the pellet.
Suspend particles in ethanol solution when performing subsequent steps.
Add a known volume of particle suspension (e.g., 10 μl) to 10 ml isotone diluent.
Count particles with a particle counting analyzer to determine concentration in stock solution.

Activate L-arginine acid group with N-(3-dimethylaminopropyl)-N′-ethylcarbodiimide hydrochloride (EDC, 0.1 nmol) and N-hydroxysuccinimide (NHS, 0.1 nmol) in ethanol for 2 hours at room temperature with gentle stirring.
Briefly sonicate particle stock solution.
Add 1 billion particles to the L-arginine solution and leave reaction for 18 hours at room temperature with gentle stirring.
Activate first aspartic acid group of N-(tert-butoxycarbonyl)-L-aspartic acid (Boc-Asp-OH, 1 nmol) with EDC (0.1 nmol)/NHS (0.1 nmol) in ethanol for 4 hours at 4 °C with gentle stirring.
Dissolve 50 mg polyethylenimine in 10 ml ethanol.
Add the polyethylenimine solution to the Boc-Asp-OH mixture.
Let reaction proceed for 24 hours at room temperature with gentle stirring.
Activate the second aspartic acid group of the Boc-Asp-OH/PEI solution with EDC and NHS at 4 °C for 6 hours with gentle stirring.
Add the particle solution from step 1.5 into the Boc-Asp-OH/PEI solution from step 1.8.
Allow the reaction to proceed for 18 hours at room temperature with gentle stirring.
Centrifuge the solution for 30 minutes at 18,800 x g.
Wash the particle solution three times with ethanol using brief sonication to suspend the pellet.
Measure the size of the particles using a scanning electron microscope (SEM).
Place a drop of particle suspension on a clean silica SEM sample stub and let dry at room temperature under vacuum.
Measure SEM images at 8 kV with a 3–5 mm working distance using an in-lens detector.
Mix 10 μl of particle suspension with 1 ml of 10 mM phosphate buffer (pH 7.4).
Load the sample into folded capillary cells and measure the zeta potential according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Dry the PCPS particles under vacuum overnight.
Add siRNA (4 μg) in nuclease-free water (20 μl) to the dried PCPS particles.
Sonicate briefly.
Incubate for 3 hr at 4 °C on a shaker (1,000 rpm).
Add DNA loading dye to 20 μl of the PCPS/control siRNA particles with different particle to siRNA ratios.
Load samples into a 2% agarose gel containing DNA gel stain.
Perform electrophoresis at a constant voltage of 120 V for 20 min in running buffer.
Analyze the gel with image acquisition and analysis software.
Mix 20 μl of the PCPS/control siRNA particles with different particle to siRNA ratios in sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS, 2%).
Let stand for 1 hr at RT.
Add DNA loading dye to the samples.
Load samples into a 2% agarose gel containing DNA gel stain.
Perform electrophoresis at a constant voltage of 120 V for 20 min in running buffer using DNA electrophoresis equipment and a power supply.
Analyze the gel with image acquisition and analysis software.
Add 5 μl of PCPS/fluorescent control siRNA particles (10 × 105 particles/0.2 μg siRNA/20 μl) to a glass cover slip.
Add PCPS/siRNA particles (10 × 10^6 PCPS particles/2 μg siRNA) to 100 μl of phosphate buffered saline.
Shake the sample at 37 °C for 2 days at 1,000 rpm.
Centrifuge the sample for 30 min at 18,800 x g and collect the supernatant.
Mix 10 μl of the supernatant with 1 ml 10 mM phosphate buffer (pH 7.4) in a plastic cuvette.
Measure the size of the particles using a particle analyzer system according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Take 10 µl of the supernatant and place on a silicon wafer.
Visualize the particles with atomic force microscopy (AFM).
Culture MDA-MB-231 human breast cancer cells in cell culture media supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum and 1% penicillin-streptomycin at 5% CO2, 95% humidity, and 37 °C.
Plate cells in 2-well culture slides at a seeding density of 3 x 10^5 cells/well for 24 hr.
Add PCPS particles loaded with fluorescent control siRNA (10 × 10^5 particles/0.2 μg particle to siRNA ratio, 50 nM siRNA) to cells.
Plate cells in 2-well culture slides at a seeding density of 3 x 10^5 cells/well for 24 hr.
Add PCPS particles loaded with fluorescent control siRNA to the cells and incubate for 1 day, 7 days, and 10 days.
Wash the cells twice with phosphate buffered saline (PBS).
Fix the cells with 4% paraformaldehyde solution for 10 min.
Wash the cells three times with PBS.
Permeabilize the cells with 0.1% octyl phenol ethoxylate for 10 min.
Block the cells with albumin from bovine serum (10 mg/ml) in PBS for 10 min at room temperature with gentle stirring.
Incubate the cells with fluorescently labeled phalloidin (1 μl/40 μl blocking solution) for 20 min at room temperature with gentle stirring.
Wash the cells in PBS.
Remove the slides from the frame and add antifade reagent with DAPI to visualize the nucleus.
Add a cover glass on top of the slides.
Take images of the cells with confocal microscopy.
Plate cells in a 6-well plate at a seeding density of 3 x 10^5 cells/well for 24 hours.
Add PCPS particles loaded with fluorescent control siRNA (10 × 10^5 particles/0.2 μg particle to siRNA ratio, 50 nM siRNA) to the cells.
Incubate the cells for 24 hours.
Wash the cells with phosphate buffered saline.
Scrape the cells with a cell scraper.
Store the cells in phosphate buffered saline with 2% fetal bovine serum prior to analysis.
Use untreated cells as a negative control.
Perform flow cytometry.
Plate cells in a 96-well plate at a cell density of 3 × 10^3 cells/well for 24 hours.

Treat the cells with PCPS particles (1.5 × 10^5/well and 6 × 10^5/well) or PCPS/control siRNA particles (10 × 10^5 particles/0.2 μg particle to siRNA ratio, 10 nM and 100 nM siRNA) for 48 hours and 72 hours.
Use untreated cells and cells treated with phosphate buffered saline (same volume as the added particles) as controls.
Assay each sample in triplicate.
Perform a cell proliferation assay according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Plate cells in a 6-well plate at a cell density of 2 × 10^5 cells/well for 24 hours.
Incubate the cells with PCPS/control siRNA (50 nM) particles or PCPS/ATM siRNA (50 nM) particles for 72 hours.
Use untreated cells as a control.
Lyse the cells using a protein extraction reagent supplemented with a protease inhibitor cocktail.
Centrifuge the cell lysates for 10 min at 14,000 x g and recover the supernatant.
Determine the protein concentration with a protein quantification assay according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Add sample loading buffer (with 5 μl 2-mercaptoethanol/ml buffer) to the samples and heat them for 6 min at 99 °C.
Load the protein samples (20 μg/μl) in a 12% SDS-polyacrylamide gel in running buffer.
Perform polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis (1 hr, 120 V).
Transfer the gel in transfer buffer (with 20% methanol) to a nitrocellulose membrane (1 hr, 100 V).
Block the membrane with 5% dry milk for 1 hr.
Incubate the membrane with the ATM primary antibody in blocking solution at a 1:1,000 dilution O/N.
Wash the membrane with phosphate buffered saline containing 0.1% polyethylene glycol sorbitan monolaurate.
Incubate the membrane with the secondary antibody (anti-rabbit) in blocking solution at a 1:2,500 dilution for 1 hr.
Wash the membrane with phosphate buffered saline containing 0.1% polyethylene glycol sorbitan monolaurate.
Detect the protein bands with Western blot detection reagent using image acquisition and analysis software.
For the loading control, wash the membrane.
Repeat steps 13.9-13.12 using a β-actin primary antibody from mouse at a 1:10,000 dilution.
Use a secondary antibody anti-mouse at a 1:4,000 dilution.
